issues.failure_explanation: The Gaussian native space is not norm-equivalent to any Sobolev space (it is a much smaller space of extremely smooth functions), so a general V* ∈ H^s need not lie in H_κ and the native-space error ‖V*−V̂‖_{H_κ} used in Step 3 is not finite or controlled. issues.failure_explanation: With V* = x² + 0.25x⁴ (V*' = 2x + x³) and f(x) = x + x³ the prescribed formula gives q(x) = ½(2x+x³)² − (2x+x³)(x+x³) = −x⁴ − ½x⁶, which is strictly negative for x ≠ 0. The 2D construction (V* = ‖x‖² + 0.25‖x‖⁴ with f(x) = x(1+‖x‖²)) gives identically q(x) = −‖x‖⁴ − ½‖x‖⁶ with the same defect.
